thesis: The speaker argues that leverage should primarily be used to amplify underlying business value rather than to artificially enhance equity returns, as excessive debt forces owners into dire situations where they must make dumb decisions to meet covenants. He advocates for a capital structure that defaults to almost all equity with no senior debt, utilizing only modest amounts of flexible seller debt to align the interests of sellers who remain invested in the business's long-term success.
